# AM29864 - 9-bit bus transceiver, inverting, 3-state

Package DIP-24 · family 29800 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/AM29864.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/AM29864.json)

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Active | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | /OER1 | enable | low |  | controls pins 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10; when not enabled: float; receive enable 1; R0-R8 drive only while /OER1 and /OER2 are both low |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 23 | T0 = NOT R0 | while /OET1 and /OET2 are low, T0 is the inverse of R0; otherwise it floats. |

|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 48 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -24 |
| inputSchmitt | yes |
| hysteresisV | 0.2 |
| notes | Commercial IOL 48 mA (VOL 0.5 V); VOH 2.4 V at -15 mA, 2.0 V at -24 mA. Input hysteresis 200 mV min on the data pins (minimum, not typical). ICC up to 160 mA (page 8-61). |

## Propagation delays

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns | Conditions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R | T | PLH | 4.0 | 5.2 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 50 pF (either direction, inverting part) |
| R | T | PHL | 4.9 | 5.9 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 50 pF (either direction, inverting part) |
| /OET1 | T | PZH | 6.5 | 12 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 50 pF (/OET to T or /OER to R) |
| /OET1 | T | PZL | 9.5 | 12 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 50 pF (/OET to T or /OER to R) |
| /OET1 | T | PHZ | 3.5 | 8.0 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 5 pF (/OET to T or /OER to R) |
| /OET1 | T | PLZ | 3.5 | 8.0 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 5 pF (/OET to T or /OER to R) |

## Not known

- The hysteresis threshold voltages are not given (only the 200 mV minimum width): vtPlusV and vtMinusV are null.
- The function table does not cover /OET and /OER both low at once (both sides driving).

## Notes

Commercial maximums over the operating range, CL 50 pF: R to T or T to R 7.0 ns (PLH), 7.5 ns (PHL); enable 15 ns; disable 9 ns at CL 5 pF (page 8-62). CL 300 pF figures are on the same page. No minimum delays given.

## Sources

- [AMD Am29861-64 High Performance Bus Transceivers (03369B), in AMD 1985 Bipolar Microprocessor Logic and Interface Data Book](http://www.bitsavers.org/components/amd/_dataBooks/1985_AMD_Bipolar_Microprocessor_Logic_and_Interface.pdf) - 8-57 to 8-63 (PDF pages 828-834); Am29864 (commercial)
